standard_position: Supplier liability is capped per claim, never at the value of the order
apparel_note: Apparel supply agreements normally cap at a fixed per-claim amount or the insured limit; a cap at order value is unusual because one defective batch can cost far more than the order.

standard_position: Liability cap of at least GBP 250,000 per claim
apparel_note: Typical apparel caps run from GBP 250,000 to GBP 2m per claim.

standard_position: Product-safety and IP claims sit outside the liability cap
apparel_note: Product-safety liability (restricted substances, flammability, small parts in children's wear) is normally uncapped in apparel; a cap on it is unusual.

standard_position: Payment at least 30 days from invoice date
apparel_note: Apparel payment terms of 30 to 90 days are normal.

standard_position: Price increases capped at 5% a year
apparel_note: Annual caps of 0 to 5% are normal for finished apparel.
Quarterly or monthly price resets are normal only for raw fabric on an index, not for finished garments.

standard_position: Force majeure suspension limited to 90 days before we may terminate
apparel_note: A 60 to 90 day limit is the norm; longer suspensions leave a season uncovered.

standard_position: At least 60 days' notice to terminate for convenience
apparel_note: Retailers need 60 to 180 days to re-source a season; 30 days is unusual.

standard_position: Cure period for material breach no longer than 30 days
At least 14 days from goods receipt to claim shortages and damage
apparel_note: Apparel norm is 14 to 45 days from goods receipt.

standard_position: Short-shipment tolerance no more than 5% of the ASN quantity
Late delivery penalty of at least 0.5% of PO value per week
apparel_note: Weekly penalties of 0.5 to 1.5% are normal in apparel.

standard_position: Designs, patterns and tooling developed for us are owned by us or jointly
apparel_note: Patterns, fits and prints made for a retailer are normally owned by the retailer; supplier ownership is unusual.

standard_position: Supplier may not reuse jointly developed IP for other customers
apparel_note: Exclusivity over retailer-specific designs is the norm.

standard_position: Improvements made with our input are assigned to us
apparel_note: Assignment or a perpetual licence of improvements is the norm.
